why_it_matters.text: A sedating antihistamine used for allergy, motion sickness, nausea and, in combination syrups, cough.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under ANDA 083312 in the Drugs@FDA data files.

description: A sedating antihistamine used for allergy, motion sickness, nausea and, in combination syrups, cough.

parts.label: The tertiary amine group
parts.sentence: A nitrogen bonded to three carbons, with no hydrogen of its own. Its spare pair of electrons can still pick up a hydrogen ion, so a tertiary amine is a base.

parts.label: The ring system
parts.sentence: Rings joined where they share atoms, or a single ring standing alone. Atoms in a ring are held in place, so this part keeps its shape while chains around it can bend.
